none: Fixed hand fan with multicolor paper leaf on front and back; handle and frame in green plastic. Front leaf has three portraits of Obama family and one portrait of Barack Obama. "Barack Obama" at lower left in white lettering with small United States flag below. Back leaf has large portrait of Obama family at center superimposed on Seal of the President of the United States; "Barack Obama" in white and multicolor lettering at bottom. Small black-and-white portrait of Obama family, bald eagle, and United States flag in wide horizontal stripe at left and right of central portrait. Manufacturer's mark on back leaf: "Abe Pe Show Prod., 0277-409548".

This collection documents the extraordinary cultural outpouring of celebratory materials from across the continent of Africa.  They represent Africa’s pride in, ownership of and hopefulness for the candidacy and presidency of Barack Obama.
